evidenceSummary.notes: First-time candidate with no voting record. Platform is broad and aspirational with limited policy specificity. The ASAP framework provides structural pillars but few concrete positions. Healthcare/maternal mortality and affordability are the only areas with repeated, substantive statements. Significant gaps exist on social issues (abortion, guns), climate, and immigration — standard Republican primary topics — which may reflect deliberate strategic ambiguity or simply undeveloped platform. Polling at 1% in GOP primary field of eight candidates. Carter Center board chair role suggests cross-partisan civic credibility but is not a policy signal.
